$comment: DuckDB extensions the -sql server build ships (docs/search.md, sql on a LanceDB index), pinned per DuckDB version and platform: scripts/build-binary.ts downloads each, checks its SHA-256 and puts it in duckdb/<version>/<platform>/ beside the binary. An extension is built for one DuckDB version, so bumping @duckdb/node-api needs entries for the new version here, and the build refuses a version it has none for. osx_arm64 is for -sql builds on a Mac, for development. DuckDB checks each extension's signature when it loads it.
